parts:
Introductory distance sampling training workshop 11-22 April 2022

Places are still available for the upcoming introductory distance sampling training workshop.  Registration closes 17 March 2022; time between the close of registration and the beginning of the workshop permits time to schedule a test session where I explain how to access learning materials and provide you with access to the RStudio/Cloud materials.

This is the last training workshop before field seasons in the Northern hemisphere get into high gear. Full details and link to registration can be found here

http://workshops.distancesampling.org/intro-apr-22.html

If you have any questions, please contact me at er26<at>st-andrews.ac.uk

Eric Rexstad

Centre for Research into Ecological and Environmental Modelling
